subject: Records of processing & audit rights — evidence request
messages:
From: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@acmecorp.com>

Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>, DPO Acme <dpo@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: records of processing, audit rights, and supporting evidence

Hi Neha,

Following our legal team's review of the SOW, Acme needs to confirm several privacy items before we can finalize the order:

- A current Records of Processing Activities (Art. 30) for the services that will process Acme data.
- Confirmation of audit rights (scope, remote vs onsite, frequency) and any constraints.
- Copies or summaries of DPIA support you provide (we need an example and any relevant findings).
- A complete list of subprocessors and their locations, plus data transfer mechanisms for EU data.

Could you share the documents or point us to the portal where this evidence lives? If certain items require a DPA amendment, please flag those and send the DocuSign link. We are on a tight procurement timeline — ideally we have these by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Julia Ramos
Contracts & Procurement
Acme Corp

(attachment: procurement-checklist.xlsx)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: ACME request — what to include in ROPA / audit stance?

Team — forwarding Acme's procurement checklist. Quick questions so I can respond with a single package:

1) ROPA: Do we send the full processing matrix (fields + purposes + retention) or a redacted version that excludes internal PICs? Acme expects Art.30 export.
2) Audit rights: our standard is to allow remote evidence review (logs, SOC2 report) and to decline unsupervised onsite access. Is that the current legal/security stance?
3) DPIA: do we have a short example DPIA summary for customers (redacted) or do we only provide guidance templates?
4) Subprocessors: our exported CSV is ready but should we annotate locations and transfer mechanism (SCCs, EU adequacy, etc.)?

I need answers by EOD so I can bundle and send.

-Neha

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 10:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: ACME request — what to include in ROPA / audit stance?

Hi — short answers below:

1) ROPA: Provide a customer-facing Art.30 ROPA (purpose, categories of data, categories of recipients, retention summary, transfers) — redact internal operational notes. Use the template in Drive (linked below).
2) Audit rights: Accept remote audits and evidence reviews (logs, queries, SOC2 + supporting artifacts). Onsite audits — decline unless customer executes the DPA amendment with the onsite clause and we schedule with Security; preference remains remote.
3) DPIA: We have a redacted DPIA summary (customer example) — send that; label it "for procurement review only."
4) Subprocessors: Provide CSV with vendor name, country, role, start date, and transfer mechanism (SCCs, adequacy decision, or controller-processor flow).

Attachments to include in the outgoing package: Redwood_ROPA_v3.pdf, DPA_Annex_Audit_Guide.docx, subprocessor_list_2026-05.csv, s3-audit-log-sample.txt

I'll review the DPA amendment language if you need it.

-Laura
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
(Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d_redwood_privacy_acme)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: records of processing, audit rights, and supporting evidence

Hi Julia — attaching the files requested and a short summary below. Please see the attached artifacts (redacted where appropriate).

Attachments included:
- Redwood_ROPA_v3.pdf (customer-facing Art.30 export)
- subprocessor_list_2026-05.csv (vendor, country, role, transfer mechanism)
- DPA_Annex_Audit_Guide.docx (explains remote evidence process and onsite terms)
- s3-audit-log-sample.txt (example of the logs we can provide for remote review)

Summary:
- Audit stance: Remote evidence review is standard and sufficient for most requests. Onsite audits are exceptional and require a DPA amendment + scheduling with security (see Annex).
- Transfers: For EU data we rely on SCCs and our subprocessors that are in adequacy countries are annotated in the CSV.
- DPIA support: see the redacted DPIA summary in the Drive link in Laura's note; we can prepare a procurement-facing summary if Acme needs more detail.

DocuSign: I have created a DPA amendment that includes the onsite-audit clause; if you want onsite access please sign here: https://www.docusign.com/rs/engage/ACME-DPA-amend

Can we schedule a 30-min scoping call Monday at 10am PT to confirm scope?

Best,
Neha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachments: Redwood_ROPA_v3.pdf, subprocessor_list_2026-05.csv, DPA_Annex_Audit_Guide.docx, s3-audit-log-sample.txt)
